subject.title: Session modelOverride persists across gateway restarts, silently overrides config default

question: Should OpenClaw keep preserving explicit and legacy session model pins across `/new`, gateway restarts, and default-model config changes, or should a reset/reconcile path clear them more aggressively?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally preserve explicit pins, while this issue asks for behavior that could override that contract and affect existing persisted sessions.

options.title: Keep pins, add explicit recovery
options.body: Preserve explicit and legacy user pins by default, but add or sponsor an explicit bulk reset/reconcile/doctor path for users who want sessions to inherit current config again.

options.title: Change reset precedence
options.body: Make `/new` or gateway restart clear more persisted model pins, accepting compatibility risk for users who intentionally pinned sessions.

options.title: Defer to resolver refactor
options.body: Track this only through the broader shared session model/auth resolver work before adding any new user-facing reset command.

recommendation.title: Keep pins, add explicit recovery
recommendation.body: Preserve explicit and legacy user pins by default, but add or sponsor an explicit bulk reset/reconcile/doctor path for users who want sessions to inherit current config again.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the current reset policy helper, status warning, and docs wording now defining the behavior under review.
